🔥 lazy-tmux | Go
🎯 Primary Use Case: Saving and restoring tmux sessions with their full state, including running commands and environment, to quickly resume work without manual setup.
✨ Key Features: • Save sessions (current, specific, or all) with detailed state including commands and scrollback. • Lazy restore functionality to minimize RAM usage. • Autosave daemon for periodic background snapshots.
📖 Summary: Lazy-tmux is a Go-based CLI tool designed to efficiently manage and save tmux sessions. It allows users to preserve detailed session states, including windows, panes, layouts, running commands, and scrollback history, enabling lazy restoration of only necessary components to conserve resources.
